title: One Replay Step
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $p$ be an input-head position, and let $u$, $v$, and $o$ be Boolean words. If the replay machine is active, its work tape contains $uv$, and its head is at position $|u|$, then one step halts with the head still at $|u|$, the tape containing $u$, and output unchanged when $v$ is empty. If $v=b::v'$ for a bit $b$, one step leaves the machine active, advances the head to $|u|+1$, keeps the tape equal to $uv$, and appends $b$ to the output.
